comment: Single source of truth for artwork shown in the gallery. Artwork is display only; there is no price, no wishlist and no purchase path. Add one object per work to the artworks array. Required: id, medium (must match a slug in gallery.json mediumPages), titleEn, titleZh, image, imageWidth, imageHeight, altEn, altZh. Optional: year (four-digit integer; omit it for an undated work and the card renders n.d.), sizeRange (small|medium|large|very-large), colors (array), style (abstract|figurative|realist), dimensionsEn, dimensionsZh. Images go in assets/gallery/. imageWidth and imageHeight are the real pixel dimensions of the file and are rendered as width/height attributes so the browser reserves layout space before the image loads.

artworks.altEn: Painting of three ripening yellow lemons and one green lime hanging among glossy dark leaves and small blossoms on a pale ground
artworks.altZh: 画作：三颗渐熟的黄柠檬与一颗青柠挂在深色亮叶与小花之间，背景浅淡

artworks.altEn: Painting of five ripe tomatoes still joined by their green vine, one cut in half to show the seeds, on a pale ground
artworks.altZh: 画作：五颗熟番茄仍连着绿色果藤，其中一颗切开露出籽瓤，背景浅淡

artworks.altEn: Painting of three deep red pomegranates hanging from a branch with blue green leaves against a graded green ground
artworks.altZh: 画作：三颗深红石榴垂挂于枝头，蓝绿色叶片衬于渐变绿色背景之上

artworks.altEn: Painting of four speckled green pears hanging from a dark red branch with a few broad leaves
artworks.altZh: 画作：四颗带斑点的青梨垂挂在深红色枝干上，旁有数片宽叶

artworks.altEn: Painting of a dense bunch of red and purple grapes beaded with water drops on a pale ground
artworks.altZh: 画作：一串密实的红紫色葡萄，果皮上凝着水珠，背景浅淡

artworks.altEn: Painting of two dark purple figs on a grey branch framed by large bright green fig leaves
artworks.altZh: 画作：两颗深紫色无花果生于灰色枝条，周围衬以宽大的鲜绿无花果叶

artworks.altEn: Painting of two full pink peony blooms on green stems against a graded green ground
artworks.altZh: 画作：两朵盛开的粉色牡丹立于绿色花茎之上，背景为渐变绿色

artworks.altEn: Painting of a peacock perched on a branch, its blue and green tail feathers falling the full height of the canvas against a silver grey ground
artworks.altZh: 画作：孔雀栖于枝上，蓝绿色尾羽垂落至画面底部，背景为银灰色

artworks.altEn: Painting of a green parrot's head in profile with a pale curved beak and red brow, on a near black ground
artworks.altZh: 画作：绿色鹦鹉头部侧面，喙呈浅色弯钩状，额前有红羽，背景近黑

artworks.altEn: Painting of a horned ram's head in profile, its curled fleece and dark face rendered in greys and white

artworks.altEn: Painting of a white dog sitting upright, its coat and the air beside it scattered with small dots of many colours on a pale grey ground
artworks.altZh: 画作：一只白狗端坐，毛皮与身旁空气中散布着多彩圆点，背景为浅灰色

artworks.altEn: Painting of a pintail duck on dark water, its brown head and patterned wing reflected below, on a deep brown ground

artworks.altEn: Painting of an orange spotted redfish swimming low over a sandy bed among pale reeds in green water
artworks.altZh: 画作：一尾带黑斑的橙色红鼓鱼贴近沙底游动，周围是绿水中的浅色水草

artworks.altEn: Painting of an orange rockfish with red fins against a deep blue ground mottled with green
artworks.altZh: 画作：橙色石斑鱼展开红色鳍条，背景为带绿色斑驳的深蓝

artworks.altEn: Painting of three orange goldfish with trailing fins swimming upward through blue water below a line of bubbles
artworks.altZh: 画作：三尾橙色金鱼拖着长鳍向上游动，蓝色水面下有一列气泡

artworks.altEn: Painting of a red cabin with lit windows under a snow covered roof, with snowy pines and blue grey mountains behind
artworks.altZh: 画作：红色木屋亮着窗灯，屋顶覆雪，身后是积雪松林与蓝灰色山峦

artworks.altEn: Coloured pencil drawing of two greyhounds pressed close together above a knitted collar, with pink cherry blossom branches across the foreground
artworks.altZh: 彩色铅笔画：两只灵缇犬紧紧相依，下方是针织围领，前景横过粉色樱花枝
